```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(glmnet); library(dplyr); library(tibble)
  library(purrr); library(reactable); library(knitr)
})
```

## What this does

Nested cross-validation of the GTEx tissue clocks. The full alpha/lambda tuning
(Step 02's search) is re-run inside each outer fold, so the reported R2/RMSE/MAE
account for hyperparameter selection, not just fitting. This validates the
*procedure*; the deployed clock is still the full-data model from Step 02. Its
alpha and lambda are shown for reference. Read-only: nothing downstream changes.

```{r helpers}
# Age-decile-stratified k folds (matches Step 02's stratification).
build_foldid <- function(y, k, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  bin <- dplyr::ntile(y, 10)
  f <- integer(length(y))
  for (b in sort(unique(bin))) {
    idx <- which(bin == b)
    f[idx] <- sample(rep(seq_len(k), length.out = length(idx)))
  }
  f
}

# Nested CV: tune (alpha grid x lambda via inner CV, lambda.1se) inside each
# outer fold, refit on outer-train, predict the held-out outer fold.
nested_oof <- function(x, y, alpha_grid, lambda_grid, outer_k, inner_k, seed) {
  outer_fold <- build_foldid(y, outer_k, seed)
  oof <- rep(NA_real_, length(y))
  for (of in seq_len(outer_k)) {
    tr <- outer_fold != of; te <- outer_fold == of
    x_tr <- x[tr, , drop = FALSE]; y_tr <- y[tr]
    inner_fold <- build_foldid(y_tr, inner_k, seed + of)

    picks <- purrr::map_dfr(alpha_grid, function(a) {
      cv <- cv.glmnet(x_tr, y_tr, alpha = a, foldid = inner_fold,
                      type.measure = "mae", lambda = lambda_grid,
                      standardize = TRUE, intercept = TRUE)
      j <- which(cv$lambda == cv$lambda.1se)
      tibble(alpha = a, lambda = cv$lambda.1se, mae = cv$cvm[j])
    })
    best <- picks[which.min(picks$mae), ]

    fit <- glmnet(x_tr, y_tr, alpha = best$alpha, lambda = best$lambda,
                  standardize = TRUE, intercept = TRUE)
    oof[te] <- as.numeric(predict(fit, newx = x[te, , drop = FALSE], s = best$lambda))
  }
  oof
}
```

```{r core}
process_one <- function(analysis_id) {
  suffix <- paste0("-", params$feature_set)
  adir   <- file.path(params$out_root, analysis_id)
  clock  <- readRDS(file.path(adir, paste0("clock_and_RAA_objects", suffix, ".rds")))
  scores <- readRDS(file.path(adir, paste0("ssgsea_scores_gtex",     suffix, ".rds")))
  meta   <- readRDS(file.path(adir, "sample_metadata.rds"))

  feat        <- clock$feature_names
  alpha_grid  <- as.numeric(clock$tuning$alpha_grid)
  lambda_grid <- as.numeric(clock$tuning$lambda_grid)
  if (length(alpha_grid) == 0) alpha_grid <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)

  # Rebuild the training matrix exactly as Step 02.
  x <- t(scores)[, feat, drop = FALSE]
  y <- meta[rownames(x), "age_years"]
  keep <- is.finite(y)
  x <- x[keep, , drop = FALSE]; y <- as.numeric(y[keep])

  oof <- nested_oof(x, y, alpha_grid, lambda_grid,
                    params$outer_k, params$inner_k, params$seed)
  ok  <- is.finite(oof) & is.finite(y)

  cv_r2   <- cor(oof[ok], y[ok])^2                                   # squared Pearson r
  # cv_r2 <- 1 - sum((oof[ok]-y[ok])^2)/sum((y[ok]-mean(y[ok]))^2)   # variance-explained alt.
  cv_rmse <- sqrt(mean((oof[ok] - y[ok])^2))
  cv_mae  <- mean(abs(oof[ok] - y[ok]))

  n_nonzero <- if (!is.null(clock$retained)) nrow(clock$retained)
               else sum(clock$clock_cs$beta != 0, na.rm = TRUE)

  tibble(
    `GTEx tissue`            = sub(".*__", "", analysis_id),
    `n GTEx`                 = length(y),
    `Age median`             = median(y),
    `Age SD`                 = round(sd(y), 2),
    `Age min`                = min(y),
    `Age max`                = max(y),
    `Input pathways`         = length(feat),
    `Nonzero-coef pathways`  = n_nonzero,
    `Nested-CV R2`           = round(cv_r2, 3),
    `Nested-CV RMSE`         = round(cv_rmse, 2),
    `Nested-CV MAE`          = round(cv_mae, 2),
    `Deployed alpha`         = as.numeric(clock$tuning$best_alpha),
    `Deployed lambda`        = signif(as.numeric(clock$tuning$best_lambda), 4)
  )
}

perf_tbl <- purrr::map_dfr(params$analyses, process_one)
```

## Table

```{r table}
knitr::kable(perf_tbl, caption = "GTEx tissue clocks: descriptors and nested-CV performance.")
reactable::reactable(perf_tbl, striped = TRUE, highlight = TRUE, defaultPageSize = 8)
```
